rules: Every rule of ai/eval/golden-meta.json applies here too.

Held-out test set of step 6.2 (c): questions and references drafted from the corpus read directly, never from retrieval output; nothing is run on them (no retrieval, no model) before the file is frozen; the first run is step 6.12 (owner, 26 Nov 2026).

No question reworks a development question or rests on the same sources: ai/eval/heldout.ts refuses a range that overlaps a development range and a required span that shares a chunk with required development evidence, and lists ranges in the same section as a development range for a reading by hand; each question names its closest development question.
One or two questions per batch are written by the owner in his own words; CC-Mac adds the facts and spans.
Version 0.x while batches are added; 1.0 is the frozen file, with its sha256 recorded in ai/DECISIONS.md.
Explanatory 'how' questions are labelled 'why' (no new category), so the counts stay comparable with the development set; their notes say so.
